scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace client && npm run test --workspace server
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run prisma:validate
